title: In Chengdu, One Cup of Tea Buys You the Whole Day | China Travel Expert
description:
In Chengdu, one cup of tea can buy you the entire day.

Chengdu has more teahouses than any city in China — over 10,000 of them. For about ¥10 you get a lidded "gaiwan" bowl of tea with bottomless hot-water refills, and a "tea doctor" (掺茶师) keeps topping you up. There's no per-table teapot and no check to rush you out — locals arrive in the morning mist and drift straight into afternoon gossip. You're not really paying for the leaves; you're leasing a bamboo chair.

🧭 Expert Tip: For the full old-school experience, grab a bamboo chair at the century-old Heming Teahouse in People's Park — ¥10–¥50, bottomless, no reservation.

在成都，一碗盖碗茶，就能坐一整天。
